name: KENT Iron Removal Filter
summary: KENT Automatic Iron Removal Filter removes excess iron from raw water and delivers clean, iron-free water at a high flow rate of 3000 L/hr . Its non-electric operation, manual backwash regeneration, and whole-house protection help prevent staining, scaling, appliance damage, and excessive soap consumption.
features: Removes excess iron from raw water
High flow rate of up to 3000 L/hr
Protects plumbing, kitchen, and bathroom appliances
Prevents rust stains on clothes and sanitary fittings
Manual backwash regeneration for easy maintenance
Ideal for residential and light commercial applications
